r-fund-unsure.title: Start with a fundamentals exam
r-fund-unsure.summary: Fundamentals exams are made for people who are new to Microsoft cloud products and show what each area is about. Take the one whose topic sounds the most interesting: AZ-900 for Azure, AI-901 for AI, DP-900 for data, SC-900 for security, PL-900 for Power Platform, GH-900 for GitHub or AB-900 for Microsoft 365 and Copilot.

r-fund-azure.title: Start with Azure Fundamentals
r-fund-azure.summary: AZ-900 covers cloud concepts, the core Azure services and how Azure is managed and governed. Its study guide calls it a common starting point for a career in Azure.

next.label: Ready for a role-based Azure exam?

r-fund-data.title: Start with Azure Data Fundamentals
r-fund-data.summary: DP-900 covers core data concepts: relational and non-relational data, and analytics workloads on Azure. It is meant for people beginning to work with data in the cloud and is not a prerequisite for the role-based data exams.

next.label: Ready for a role-based data exam?

r-fund-ai.title: Start with Azure AI Fundamentals
r-fund-ai.summary: AI-901 is for people at the beginning of a career in AI solution development: AI concepts and building AI solutions with Microsoft Foundry, with some Python. It continues the Azure AI Fundamentals certification of the retired AI-900.

next.label: Ready to build AI apps and agents?

r-fund-m365.title: Microsoft 365 administration, from the basics
r-fund-m365.summary: AB-900 is the fundamentals exam: the core features of Microsoft 365, data protection and governance, and basic administration of Copilot and agents. AB-650 is the role-based exam to take once you administer a tenant day to day.

r-fund-security.title: Start with Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals
r-fund-security.summary: SC-900 covers the basics of security, compliance and identity across Microsoft cloud services, including Microsoft Entra. Its study guide welcomes business stakeholders, IT professionals and students alike.

next.label: Ready for a role-based security exam?

r-fund-power.title: Start with Power Platform Fundamentals
r-fund-power.summary: PL-900 shows what Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse and Copilot Studio agents can do, for people starting to build with Power Platform. There is no Dynamics 365 fundamentals exam any more, and the Dynamics 365 Sales and Contact Center exams expect Power Platform knowledge, so PL-900 is a good start there too.

next.label: Ready for a role-based Power Platform or Dynamics 365 exam?

r-fund-github.title: Start with GitHub Foundations
r-fund-github.summary: GH-900 covers the basics of GitHub: repositories, collaboration, Git and project management.

next.label: Ready for a role-based GitHub exam?

r-ai-professional.title: AI Business Professional
r-ai-professional.summary: AB-730 is for people who use Microsoft 365 Copilot and prebuilt agents to improve their daily work, without building AI apps or writing code. You should be comfortable with Outlook, Word, Teams, PowerPoint and Excel.

r-ai-leader.title: AI Transformation Leader
r-ai-leader.summary: AB-731 is for business decision-makers who guide AI adoption: spotting opportunities, choosing AI tools and planning adoption. No coding is expected, but experience leading change in a business is.

r-gh-business.title: Agentic AI for operational efficiency
r-gh-business.summary: GH-700 is for product managers, program managers, project managers and business analysts who use GitHub and GitHub Copilot to improve their work and build agentic workflows. It does not need deep coding experience.

r-azure-admin.title: Azure Administrator
r-azure-admin.summary: AZ-104 is for people who implement, manage and monitor Azure: identity, governance, storage, compute and virtual networks. It also counts toward two expert certifications, the ones of AZ-305 and AZ-401.

r-azure-network.title: Azure networking
r-azure-network.summary: AZ-700 is for network engineers who design, implement and manage Azure networking: core infrastructure, hybrid connectivity, application delivery, private access and network security.

r-windows-server.title: Windows Server administration
r-windows-server.summary: AZ-802 is for administrators who deploy, manage and troubleshoot Windows Server on premises, in the cloud or in hybrid setups, including Active Directory Domain Services. Microsoft consolidated the retired AZ-800 and AZ-801 into this exam.

r-azure-avd.title: Azure Virtual Desktop
r-azure-avd.summary: AZ-140 is for server and desktop administrators who design, implement and maintain Azure Virtual Desktop and remote apps.

r-azure-sap.title: SAP workloads on Azure
r-azure-sap.summary: AZ-120 is for architects and engineers who design and run SAP landscapes on Azure. Its study guide strongly recommends holding the Azure Administrator Associate certification (AZ-104) first; skip that step if you already hold it.

r-devops.title: Agentic DevOps
r-devops.summary: AZ-401 covers DevOps with AI assistance across Azure DevOps and GitHub: source control, build and release pipelines, security and monitoring. It replaces AZ-400 and leads to the Agentic DevOps Engineer Expert certification.

r-devops-prereq.title: Agentic DevOps, with its prerequisite first
r-devops-prereq.summary: To earn the certification of AZ-401 you need to have passed AZ-104 or GH-300. Take AZ-104 if you run Azure, or GH-300 if you write code with GitHub Copilot, then AZ-401.

r-azure-dev.title: Developing AI cloud solutions on Azure
r-azure-dev.summary: AI-200 is for developers who build the back end of AI solutions on Azure: containers, data services, messaging and secure integration, with Python. It replaced the retired AZ-204.

r-azure-ai-apps.title: AI apps and agents on Azure
r-azure-ai-apps.summary: AI-103 is for AI engineers who build and deploy agents and AI solutions with Microsoft Foundry: generative AI, computer vision, text analysis and information extraction, in Python. It replaced the retired AI-102 and also counts toward the AB-100 architect certification.

r-azure-multi-agent.title: Multi-agent AI solutions
r-azure-multi-agent.summary: AI-500 is for expert-level practitioners who design, build and run production systems of several cooperating agents with Microsoft Foundry, Microsoft Agent Framework and MCP. Its study guide expects experience deploying agentic systems in production.

r-azure-mlops.title: Machine learning and generative AI in production
r-azure-mlops.summary: AI-300 is for people with a data science background who run AI in production: MLOps with Azure Machine Learning and GenAIOps with Microsoft Foundry. It also counts toward the AB-100 architect certification.

r-dev-cosmos.title: AI applications on Azure Cosmos DB
r-dev-cosmos.summary: DP-420 is for developers who build AI applications on Azure Cosmos DB: data models, queries, retrieval and agent memory, in C# or Python.

r-dev-sql.title: AI-enabled database solutions
r-dev-sql.summary: DP-800 is for developers who build AI-enabled database solutions on SQL Server, Azure SQL and SQL databases in Microsoft Fabric, with T-SQL, embeddings and vectors.

r-power-analyst.title: Data analysis with Power BI
r-power-analyst.summary: PL-300 is for analysts who prepare, model, visualize and share data in Power BI, using Power Query and DAX.

r-fabric-analytics.title: Analytics in Microsoft Fabric
r-fabric-analytics.summary: DP-600 is for people who build analytics assets in Microsoft Fabric: preparing data and building semantic models, warehouses and lakehouses with SQL, KQL and DAX. DP-700 is the Fabric data engineering exam.

r-fabric-engineer.title: Data engineering in Microsoft Fabric
r-fabric-engineer.summary: DP-700 is for data engineers who ingest, transform and orchestrate data in Microsoft Fabric with SQL, PySpark and KQL. DP-600 is the Fabric analytics exam.

r-databricks.title: Data engineering on Azure Databricks
r-databricks.summary: DP-750 is for data engineers who build and run data pipelines on Azure Databricks and govern data with Unity Catalog, using SQL and Python.

r-sql-admin.title: Azure SQL administration
r-sql-admin.summary: DP-300 is for database administrators who run Azure SQL and SQL Server: security, performance, automation, high availability and migration.

r-m365-admin.title: Administering Microsoft 365 and AI services
r-m365-admin.summary: AB-650 is for administrators who configure, secure and govern Microsoft 365 tenants and AI services, including Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents. It expects experience with Microsoft 365 workloads, Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft Graph PowerShell, and it replaces MS-102.

r-m365-endpoint.title: Managing endpoints with Intune
r-m365-endpoint.summary: MD-102 is for endpoint administrators who deploy, manage and protect devices and apps with Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot and Defender for Endpoint.

r-m365-teams.title: Microsoft Teams administration
r-m365-teams.summary: MS-700 is for Teams administrators who configure and manage teams, channels, chat, apps, events and calling. If you also run phones and meeting rooms, MS-721 covers them in depth.

r-m365-calling.title: Teams Phone, meetings and devices
r-m365-calling.summary: MS-721 is for engineers who plan, deploy and troubleshoot Teams Phone, meetings, webinars, town halls, Teams Rooms and devices. MS-700 covers the wider administration of Teams.

r-sec-soc.title: Security operations
r-sec-soc.summary: SC-200 is for security operations analysts who triage incidents, hunt threats with KQL and automate responses with Microsoft Defender XDR and Microsoft Sentinel. It also counts toward the SC-100 cybersecurity architect certification.

r-sec-identity.title: Identity and access
r-sec-identity.summary: SC-300 is for administrators who design, implement and run identity and access with Microsoft Entra: user and workload identities, authentication and governance. It also counts toward the SC-100 cybersecurity architect certification.

r-sec-information.title: Information protection and compliance
r-sec-information.summary: SC-401 is for administrators who protect sensitive data in Microsoft 365 and in AI services with Microsoft Purview: information protection, data loss prevention, retention and insider risk.

r-sec-cloud.title: Security for cloud and AI workloads
r-sec-cloud.summary: SC-500 is for security engineers who secure identity, networks, storage, databases, compute and AI workloads across Azure and hybrid environments. It replaced AZ-500 and also counts toward the SC-100 cybersecurity architect certification.

r-power-apps.title: Building intelligent applications on Power Platform
r-power-apps.summary: AB-410 is for people who build AI-powered apps, Dataverse data models and cloud flows with low-code tools, Copilot and agents. It replaced the retired PL-200 and also counts toward the AB-100 architect certification.

r-power-developer.title: Extending Power Platform with code and AI
r-power-developer.summary: AB-400 is for developers who extend Power Platform with code and generative AI: custom user experiences, integrations and automation in languages such as JavaScript, TypeScript, C# and Power Fx. It is the updated PL-400, leads to the same Power Platform Developer Associate certification and counts toward AB-100.

r-ai-copilot-studio.title: Agents in Copilot Studio
r-ai-copilot-studio.summary: AB-620 is for professional developers and advanced builders who build, extend and integrate custom agents in Copilot Studio, including Microsoft Foundry, MCP and multi-agent solutions. It also counts toward the AB-100 architect certification.

r-dyn-sales.title: AI in Dynamics 365 Sales
r-dyn-sales.summary: AB-210 is for people who configure Dynamics 365 Sales, Copilot in Sales and agents to help sellers from lead to cash; its study guide recommends intermediate Power Platform configuration training first. It also counts toward the AB-100 architect certification.

r-dyn-service.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service
r-dyn-service.summary: MB-230 is for functional consultants who implement Dynamics 365 Customer Service: cases, knowledge, queues, service-level agreements and routing. It also counts toward the AB-100 architect certification.

r-dyn-contact-center.title: AI in Dynamics 365 Contact Center
r-dyn-contact-center.summary: AB-250 is for contact center engineers and functional consultants who build AI-powered contact centers in Dynamics 365 Contact Center: channels, routing and self-service agents. It also counts toward the AB-100 architect certification.

r-dyn-finance.title: Dynamics 365 Finance
r-dyn-finance.summary: MB-310 is for functional consultants who implement Dynamics 365 Finance, such as the general ledger, payables, receivables, budgeting and fixed assets. It also counts toward the AB-100 architect certification.

r-dyn-supply.title: AI-powered supply chain operations
r-dyn-supply.summary: AB-330 is for consultants who implement supply chain processes and AI capabilities in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management. It replaces MB-330.

r-dyn-other.title: Not covered on this hub yet
r-dyn-other.summary: The hub has no pages for the other Dynamics 365 exams yet, such as Business Central or Finance and Operations development (MB-500). Microsoft's certification poster lists every Dynamics 365 exam.

r-gh-admin.title: GitHub Enterprise Administrator
r-gh-admin.summary: GH-100 is for administrators who run GitHub Enterprise Cloud or Server: identities and access, governance, GitHub Actions and secure development features such as GitHub Advanced Security.

r-gh-actions.title: GitHub Actions
r-gh-actions.summary: GH-200 is for engineers who automate software workflows with GitHub Actions: writing workflows and actions, and managing and securing them at scale.

r-gh-security.title: GitHub Advanced Security
r-gh-security.summary: GH-500 is for people who secure code, secrets and dependencies with GitHub Advanced Security and triage and fix its alerts.

r-gh-copilot.title: GitHub Copilot
r-gh-copilot.summary: GH-300 is for developers who use GitHub Copilot responsibly and productively, including prompt engineering and privacy settings. Passing it also counts toward the AZ-401 agentic DevOps certification.

r-gh-agentic.title: Developing in agentic AI systems
r-gh-agentic.summary: GH-600 is for people who run, supervise and govern AI coding agents in the software development process, using GitHub to control and review what the agents do.

r-arch-azure.title: Azure Solutions Architect
r-arch-azure.summary: AZ-305 is the expert-level exam for people who design Azure solutions: identity, governance, data storage, business continuity and infrastructure. With your AZ-104 certification, it earns you the Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification.

r-arch-azure-prereq.title: Azure Solutions Architect, with its prerequisite first
r-arch-azure-prereq.summary: The Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification needs both AZ-305 and the Azure Administrator Associate certification, so take AZ-104 first. AZ-305 then tests how you design identity, data, business continuity and infrastructure solutions.

r-arch-security.title: Cybersecurity Architect
r-arch-security.summary: SC-100 is the expert-level exam for people who design security strategies that follow Zero Trust across identity, devices, data, AI, applications and infrastructure. Your SC-200, SC-300 or SC-500 certification is the prerequisite it needs.

r-arch-security-prereq.title: Cybersecurity Architect, with its prerequisite first
r-arch-security-prereq.summary: The certification of SC-100 needs one of these: SC-200 for security operations, SC-300 for identity and access, or SC-500 for cloud and AI workload security. Take the one closest to your work, then SC-100.

r-arch-ai.title: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect
r-arch-ai.summary: AB-100 is the expert-level exam for solution architects who plan, design and deploy AI-powered business solutions and agents across Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry. You already hold a certification it accepts.

r-arch-ai-dynamics.title: Agentic AI architect, starting from Dynamics 365
r-arch-ai-dynamics.summary: AB-100 needs one of its prerequisite certifications first. Take the exam of the Dynamics 365 app you know best: Sales (AB-210), Contact Center (AB-250), Customer Service (MB-230) or Finance (MB-310), then AB-100.

r-arch-ai-power.title: Agentic AI architect, starting from Power Platform
r-arch-ai-power.summary: AB-100 needs one of its prerequisite certifications first. Take AB-410 if you build with low code, AB-400 if you extend Power Platform with code, or AB-620 if you build agents in Copilot Studio, then AB-100.

r-arch-ai-azure.title: Agentic AI architect, starting from Azure AI
r-arch-ai-azure.summary: AB-100 needs one of its prerequisite certifications first. Take AI-103 if you build AI apps and agents, or AI-300 if you run machine learning and generative AI in production, then AB-100.

r-next-az-104.title: After AZ-104
r-next-az-104.summary: AZ-104 counts toward two expert certifications: AZ-305 for designing Azure solutions and AZ-401 for agentic DevOps. For SAP on Azure, the AZ-120 study guide strongly recommends the certification you already hold.

r-next-gh-300.title: After GH-300
r-next-gh-300.summary: Passing GH-300 meets the prerequisite of AZ-401, the agentic DevOps exam across GitHub and Azure DevOps.

r-next-fundamentals.title: After a fundamentals exam
r-next-fundamentals.summary: The next level is a role-based exam in the area you want to work in. Role-based exams test practical skills and can be very difficult without hands-on experience, so plan time for practice.

link.label: How to Prepare for Role-Based Exams

r-next-other.title: Broaden into another area
r-next-other.summary: None of the current expert certifications on this hub lists your certification as a prerequisite. Pick the next area you want to learn, or see how the certification poster shows each path.

link.label: How to read the certification poster

r-renew.title: Renew instead of retaking the exam
r-renew.summary: Associate, Expert and Specialty certifications are renewed every year with an online renewal assessment, which you must finish before the certification expires; Fundamentals and Business certifications do not expire. The renewal guide explains how.

r-partner.title: Certifications for Microsoft partners
r-partner.summary: Microsoft partner designations count specific certifications. The partner guide lists the certifications each designation asks for and links the ones that have study materials on this hub.

next.label: Or pick an exam by your role

r-retired-other.title: Retired exams
r-retired-other.summary: The archive keeps the study pages of retired exams the hub covered, with what is known about their successors. Some retired exams have no direct replacement.

next.label: Pick an exam by your role instead

r-replace-pl-600.title: After PL-600
r-replace-pl-600.summary: Microsoft retired PL-600 and its certification. The hub's former PL-600 page named AB-100, the agentic AI business solutions architect exam, as a possible next step for some candidates, not as a direct replacement.

r-replace-mb-280.title: After MB-280
r-replace-mb-280.summary: Microsoft retired MB-280. The hub's former MB-280 page pointed learners to AB-210, the AI exam for Dynamics 365 Sales.

r-architect-other.title: No architect exam for this area on the hub
r-architect-other.summary: The hub has architect-level exam pages for Azure (AZ-305), security (SC-100) and AI and agent solutions (AB-100). For any other area, Microsoft's certification poster lists every certification, or you can pick an exam by your role.

next.label: Pick an exam by your role
